newsitem.title: USA: California Air National Guard aiding ill fisherman.
newsitem.headline: California Air National Guard aiding ill fisherman.

text.p: California's Air National Guard flew to rescue a fisherman who radioed for help for a medical emergency more than 600 miles off the California coast, officials said Sunday.
A three-member rescue team parachuted late Saturday from a C-130 aircraft to treat the fisherman who had a blood clot aboard a 58-foot fishing board.
Air National Guard Maj. Art Haubold said the man, who was not identified, was in stable condition.
An Air National Guard aircraft and helicopter will return to the fishing boat later Sunday to bring the injured man and the rescue team back to shore.
Haubold said it would take the plane and helicopter more than 10 hours to make the 1,200-mile round trip. The helicopter will be refueled several times by the aircraft during the flight.
